result.reason: The addition reaches the preferred position: Licensee may terminate on 30 days' written notice, receives a refund of prepaid fees attributable to the post-termination period, owes no early-termination charge, and Licensor receives no convenience-termination right during the committed term. However, permitting termination “in part” exceeds the playbook and could materially affect scope and pricing without addressing allocation mechanics. Apart from that overreach, the language is professionally drafted, though expressly stating that the refund is pro rata would be clearer.
